title: Fix Elantech touchpad not detected due to vcc error
summary: If your Elantech touchpad is not detected and you see a 'supply vcc not found' error in the journal, forcing the psmouse module to use the primary bus often fixes it.
error_patterns: supply vcc not found, using dummy regulator

steps.explain: Create the file /etc/modprobe.d/psmouse.conf with the following content to force the psmouse module to use the primary bus.
Reload the psmouse module or reboot to apply the change.

rollback.explain: Reload the psmouse module or reboot to revert changes.

warnings: If the touchpad is detected but still does not work, you may need to blacklist the elan_i2c kernel module instead.
